decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, Inland Real Estate Income Trust uses net loss rather than comprehensive loss as its EPS numerator. Its filing explicitly excludes restricted shares as anti-dilutive: 7,820 in 2023, 9,717 in 2024 and 12,087 in 2025. Those excluded shares are not added to the weighted-average denominator. The statement heading scales dollar amounts, not share counts; shares and EPS retain scale-zero tags.

decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, Alkami uses net loss attributable to common stockholders as its EPS numerator. Potential shares are excluded as anti-dilutive in each loss period; the disclosure continues across a page break. The excluded-equivalent table includes stock options, RSUs, employee stock purchase shares and, in 2025, convertible notes. These are not additional weighted-average shares. Shares and per-share amounts are exempt from the thousands heading and retain scale-zero tags without altering reported values.
